dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Oreo Milkshake has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to retreat quickly and hide from handlers when they attempt to interact. His previous owner states that he will hard bark and growl at strangers and will also lunge at strangers while on leash. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Oreo Milkshake
